verdict.rationale: Mercury's own launch post describes the Books accounting API and MCP layer only as coming 'Soon', so there is no shipped way to run Books headlessly or in CI. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt both returned 404. Programmatic invoicing belongs to Mercury's separate invoicing product, so it is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for headless Books automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
